io.milvus.pool

Class PoolConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.pool.PoolConfig

  • public class PoolConfig
extends Object
    Configuration for the Milvus client pool, controlling the pool size, blocking and eviction behavior.

    Limits are expressed per key (endpoint) and for the pool as a whole. Default values match a small client-side pool: one minimum idle client per key, a maximum of five idle clients per key and a maximum of 1000 total clients.
